				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_0  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>Book your cabin</h2></div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_2 et_section_regular" >
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_1">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et_pb_column_1  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_1  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>Caycuse Cabins at Nitinaht Windsurf Park</h2>
<p>If you have a love for the great outdoors with indoor comforts visit us at Nitinaht Lake Campgrounds.</p>
<p>Six new cozy 1-bedroom cabins each included with kitchenette, pull out couch, bathroom with shower, and wrap-around decks with BBQ, and propane fire ring.</p>
<p>Located in a forest setting within the park perfect for West Coast Trail users requiring overnight accommodation (pre or post hike) kiteboarders or a getaway retreat.</div>
			</div>
			</div>

			</div><div id="conditions" class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_5 et_pb_with_background et_section_regular" >
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_3 et_pb_equal_columns">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_3  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_2  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h3>Terms and Conditions</h3>
<p>Caycuse Cabins open year-round. Minimum 2 night stay.</p>
<p><strong>RESERVATIONS</strong><br />Booking Online only. <strong>Payment is by Debit/Credit card. No cash.</strong></p>
<p>$220/per night for a no pet cabin; $245/night for a pet friendly cabin.<br />Full Payment is required for all dates booked.<br />Any changes to the booking date are subject to a $50 change fee. Dates may be changed, subject to availability and are subject to the cancellation policy.</p>
<p><strong>SITE OCCUPANCY</strong><br />• Cabins are 1 bedroom and prices are based on double occupancy. As there is a hide-a-bed, 2 additional family members are invited to share.<br />• Maximum 4 persons per cabin.<strong></strong><strong></strong></p></div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_4  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_3  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><strong>SITE COMPOSITION<br />
</strong>• The permit holder is responsible for the conduct and behavior of their family within the cabins’ area.<br />
• Maximum 1 vehicle per site.<br />
• Check in time is 3:00pm<br />
• Check out time is 11:00am<br />
• Management reserves the right to refuse entry to any person.<br />
• Management reserves the right to refuse service to anyone for violating cabin or campground rules, destructive behavior or creating a disturbance or undermining authority of the campsite staff or the Ditidaht people.</p>
<p><strong>CANCELLATION AND REFUND POLICY</strong><br />
• Any cancellations received within 14 days of the scheduled arrival will result in a forfeiture of your entire payment.<br />
• Cancellations received prior to the 14-day period are subject to 50% cancellation fee. The remainder will be refunded to your credit card.<br />
• We do not give credit or refunds due to weather conditions.<br />
• Inquiries, changes and cancellations will only be accepted by email at <a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#9dfff2f2f6f4f3faeeddf3f4e9f4f3fcf5e9fefcf0edfaeff2e8f3f9b3fef2f0"><span class="__cf_email__" data-cfemail="caa8a5a5a1a3a4adb98aa4a3bea3a4aba2bea9aba7baadb8a5bfa4aee4a9a5a7">[email&#160;protected]</span></a>. We do not accept cancellations over the phone or in person.</div>
			</div>

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p><span style="color: #000000;"><strong>Nitinaht Tourism</strong></span></p>
<p>The Nitinaht Region on the west coast of Vancouver Island ls home to some of the most wondrous natural and cultural sights and experiences - all in one beautiful, remarkable, untouched place.</p></div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_4 et_pb_column_7  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_6  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_dark">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p><span style="color: #000000;"><strong>Nitinaht Entrance West Coast Trail</strong></span></p>
<p>We are home to the new Parks Canada 3rd entrance to the West Coast Trail. Start here for shorter hikes and 'weekend warrior' overnight Comfort Camping.</p></div>
			</div>

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p><span style="color: #000000;"><strong>Ditidaht Development</strong></span></p>
<p>The mandate of the Ditidaht Economic Development Corporation is to optimize existing resources and businesses and identify new opportunities.</p></div>
